title: Watching a Sunrise After a Long Night
paragraphs: After finishing an overnight shift at the hospital, Dewi decided, unusually, to drive to a nearby hill rather than heading straight home to sleep as she normally did every other morning.
Sitting alone watching the sky slowly change color, she felt her exhaustion mix strangely with a sense of calm she rarely experienced during her typically rushed mornings after work.
A stranger nearby, also watching quietly, mentioned that he came here every week specifically to reset his mind before starting a new day, regardless of how his previous day had gone.
Driving home afterward, Dewi felt more refreshed than sleep alone usually provided, and she decided this small detour was worth repeating occasionally after particularly difficult night shifts.
